Role Description The Social Media Marketing Manager will be responsible for planning, executing, and optimizing social media strategies across multiple platforms to grow brand awareness and engagement. Day-to-day tasks include developing and scheduling content calendars, coordinating with design and content teams, monitoring social media channels, and responding to audience interactions in a professional manner. The role involves analyzing performance metrics, preparing regular reports, and recommending improvements based on data insights and current digital trends. The Social Media Marketing Manager will collaborate with marketing and business teams to support campaigns for events, digital marketing initiatives, and brand promotions. This is a full-time, on-site role based in Al Amerat.
q: Candidates should possess strong Social Media Marketing and Social Media Optimization (SMO) skills, including experience managing brand presence on major platforms.

Candidates should possess practical Content Strategy skills, such as planning content calendars, aligning messaging with brand goals, and tailoring content to target audiences.
